scope: All seventy-seven unresolved private-nonprofit institutions in the alphabetical Q, R, and S segments
safeguards: Only official institution-owned employee pages, institution-specific ATS tenants, or direct faculty vacancy pages were promoted.
Student and alumni career services, external ministry boards, stale vacancy pages, and unrelated affiliated employers were rejected.
Merged identities, specialty schools without public employee boards, and pages without a durable vacancy index remained unresolved.
Live production probes removed navigation labels, handbook and policy links, application instructions, and other false faculty matches.
